paper.title: Early fibrotic niches establish tumour-permissive microenvironments

companion_paper_required_for_the_communi.title: Sustained NF-kB activation allows mutant alveolar stem cells to co-opt a regeneration program for tumor initiation
companion_paper_required_for_the_communi.note: reference 7 of the Nature paper; its RFP+ mutant epithelial cells are the epithelial half of the CellChat object. The Nature paper's data-availability statement does not name this accession.

model.labelling: RFP+ marks the KrasG12D-coupled clone; other Confetti colours mark labelled wild-type clones
model.induction: tamoxifen by oral gavage, 0.2 mg per g body weight, two to four doses every other day; 0.1 mg/g single dose for clonal analysis
model.note_on_condition: homeostasis is the condition of the Confetti arm, not a property of the strain

epithelium_to_fibroblast.method: CellChat on an integration of England 2025 RFP+ epithelium with this paper's Red2Kras and Confetti fibroblasts
epithelium_to_fibroblast.comparison_actually_made: differential source: AT2 cells versus DATP-like cells, same target (alveolar fibroblasts)
not_reported: sensitivity to how the DATP-like cluster is defined

fibroblast_to_epithelium.method: CellChat, reverse leg on the same object
fibroblast_to_epithelium.note: less examined in the paper than the Areg leg

fibroblast_to_macrophage.method: top differentially expressed gene of reprogrammed versus homeostatic alveolar fibroblasts, plus receptor expression across immune populations
fibroblast_to_macrophage.causation_tested_by: recombinant Tnc on wild-type AMs with and without the TLR4 inhibitor TAK-242, in vitro only

macrophage_to_fibroblast.claim: IL-1beta from reprogrammed AMs induces Lcn2+ inflammatory fibroblasts
macrophage_to_fibroblast.evidence: co-culture and recombinant IL-1beta, Extended Data Fig. 4p-q

perturbations.name: MRTX1133
perturbations.schedule: 15 mg/kg intraperitoneally twice daily for 10 days from 4 weeks post-induction

perturbations.name: gefitinib
perturbations.schedule: 80 mg/kg intraperitoneally every 4 days for 20 days from 4 days after the last tamoxifen dose

perturbations.name: Areg-flox
perturbations.schedule: Aregflox/flox versus Aregflox/+ on the Red2Kras background, 2 weeks
perturbations.readout: tumour burden (15 versus 15 mice) and scRNA-seq (GSE316244)

perturbations.name: clodronate liposomes
perturbations.schedule: 5 intratracheal doses from 2 days after the last tamoxifen dose
perturbations.readout: tumour size, neutrophil and gamma-delta recruitment

perturbations.name: diphtheria toxin
perturbations.schedule: 50 ng per mouse intratracheally every other day for 7 doses after organoid engraftment

enrichment.input: top 300 DEGs for the fibroblast comparison

their_pipeline.doublet_removal: not stated; no dedicated caller named

statistics.unit: mouse, or independent experiment for in vitro work
statistics.nesting: 10 to 20 tumours or at least 7 fields per mouse, averaged to a mouse-level value before testing
statistics.note: nested analyses stated to agree with the averaged ones

external_datasets_reanalysed.role: bleomycin injury mesenchyme, for the shared fibroblast state
external_datasets_reanalysed.citation: Tsukui et al. 2020, Nat Commun, doi:10.1038/s41467-020-15647-5

external_datasets_reanalysed.role: early-stage human LUAD and matched normal
external_datasets_reanalysed.filter_applied_by_the_paper: EGFR wild-type only, 6 LUAD and 6 normal, 5 matched pairs

GSE316244.content: Areg-flox/+ and Areg-flox/flox: niche and RFP+ epithelium

GSE310335.content: human alveolar organoids, control and KRASG12D

GSE247505.content: England 2025 lineage-labelled RFP+ and YFP+ epithelium
GSE247505.note: two replicate libraries per arm; the only time course in the reusable set

constraints_carried_into_this_repository.statistical_unit: the mouse; every deposited mouse library pools three mice, so no genotype contrast in the deposit has within-group replication and no P value is admissible on it
constraints_carried_into_this_repository.no_mesenchymal_or_immune_time_course: all mesenchymal and immune libraries are a single time point (2 weeks), so the paper's fibroblast-before-macrophage ordering cannot be tested transcriptomically
constraints_carried_into_this_repository.gene_space: libraries were aligned with different CellRanger versions; integration needs an explicit intersection on Ensembl gene ID
constraints_carried_into_this_repository.cellchat: infers communication from ligand-receptor co-expression and has no proximity information; a hit without spatial support is a hypothesis
constraints_carried_into_this_repository.isoform_resolution: short-read 3' data cannot resolve Tnc variable FNIII domain usage or isoform switching; this is a limitation to state, not a plan to execute
